nl: A hospital manages a small set of scheduled surgeries that must each move through the same lifecycle: waiting in the unscheduled pool, occupying an operating room, and finally completed. Every surgery begins in the pool. Before a surgery may be placed into a free operating room, a committee of on-call physicians casts votes for it, and a placement is only allowed once a quorum of distinct physicians has voted for that particular surgery. A separate privileged action lets a hospital administrator override the committee and place a waiting surgery into a free room directly, without waiting for quorum. When the surgery in a room finishes, the room is freed and the surgery becomes completed. A completed surgery may later be reopened for a follow-up procedure, returning it to the unscheduled pool. The whole system tracks the same fixed roster of surgeries forever: no surgery is ever duplicated, invented, or lost, so at every instant each surgery sits in exactly one of the three stages. SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state the unscheduled pool, the set of surgeries currently occupying rooms, and the set of completed surgeries form a partition of the fixed surgery roster (they are pairwise disjoint and together cover exactly the roster).
spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m5p2t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgeries, Rooms, Physicians, Quorum, NULL

VARIABLES pool, room, done, ballot
vars == <<pool, room, done, ballot>>

Occupied == { r \in Rooms : room[r] # NULL }
InRooms  == { room[r] : r \in Occupied }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \subseteq Surgeries
    /\ room \in [Rooms -> Surgeries \cup {NULL}]
    /\ done \subseteq Surgeries
    /\ ballot \in [Surgeries -> SUBSET Physicians]

Init ==
    /\ pool = Surgeries
    /\ room = [r \in Rooms |-> NULL]
    /\ done = {}
    /\ ballot = [s \in Surgeries |-> {}]

Vote(p, s) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ p \notin ballot[s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = ballot[s] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, room, done>>

Commit(s, r) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ room[r] = NULL
    /\ Cardinality(ballot[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ pool' = pool \ {s}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED done

AdminAssign(s, r) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ room[r] = NULL
    /\ pool' = pool \ {s}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED done

Complete(r) ==
    /\ room[r] # NULL
    /\ done' = done \cup {room[r]}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, ballot>>

Reopen(s) ==
    /\ s \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {s}
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<room, ballot>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Physicians, s \in Surgeries : Vote(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms : Commit(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms : AdminAssign(s, r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Complete(r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries : Reopen(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation ==
    /\ pool \cup InRooms \cup done = Surgeries
    /\ pool \cap InRooms = {}
    /\ pool \cap done = {}
    /\ InRooms \cap done = {}
=============================================================================

nl: A network of vending machines shares a single replicated stock-count register that is updated with a compare-and-swap discipline. The register carries a version number that increases by one every time a write commits. Each machine first reads the register, remembering the version it saw, and later submits a write request stamped with that remembered version. Because the network reorders messages, write requests may arrive at the register in any order, not the order they were sent. When a request reaches the register it commits only if the version it carries still matches the register's current version; on commit the register records which machine won that version slot and advances the version. A request whose stamped version no longer matches is stale and is discarded, so it never overwrites a value it never saw. When the register reaches its cycle limit it is reset for the next restock round. SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state the record of per-version winners is filled exactly on the prefix below the current version and empty at and above it, so every committed version has exactly one recorded writer and no committed update is ever lost or overwritten.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m7p1t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxVer, NONE

VARIABLES ver, winner, seen, inflight
vars == <<ver, winner, seen, inflight>>

Slots == 0 .. (MaxVer - 1)

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ winner \in [Slots -> Machines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ seen \in [Machines -> 0 .. MaxVer]
    /\ inflight \subseteq (Machines \X (0 .. MaxVer))

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ winner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ seen = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ inflight = {}

Read(m) ==
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![m] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, inflight>>

Submit(m) ==
    /\ <<m, seen[m]>> \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<m, seen[m]>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, seen>>

Deliver(m, e) ==
    /\ <<m, e>> \in inflight
    /\ e = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ winner' = [winner EXCEPT ![ver] = m]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED seen

Drop(m, e) ==
    /\ <<m, e>> \in inflight
    /\ e # ver
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, seen>>

Cycle ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ winner' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ seen' = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ inflight' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Read(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Submit(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, e \in 0 .. MaxVer : Deliver(m, e)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, e \in 0 .. MaxVer : Drop(m, e)
    \/ Cycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A s \in Slots : (s < ver) <=> (winner[s] # NONE)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2, m3}
    MaxVer = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

nl: A container-ship crane yard has several cranes that must take turns using a single shared transfer bay. The yard is reconfigured over time through numbered epochs; every reconfiguration bumps the current epoch and revokes any outstanding permission to use the bay. A crane may be granted the bay only after it has synchronized its own knowledge to the current epoch, and only one grant token exists at a time. Holding the token, a crane may enter the bay, but only when the bay is unoccupied; it later exits and returns the token. Any crane can crash silently at any moment: it simply stops, and if it was inside the bay it is removed and the token is freed so the yard is not stuck forever. A crashed crane may later be recovered. Throughout all of this the bay must never hold two cranes at once. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state any two cranes that are simultaneously inside the transfer bay must in fact be the same crane, so the bay is occupied by at most one crane at a time.
spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m9p0t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxEpoch, NONE

VARIABLES epoch, token, inBay, known, crashed
vars == <<epoch, token, inBay, known, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ token \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ inBay \subseteq Cranes
    /\ known \in [Cranes -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ token = NONE
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ known = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ token' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inBay, known, crashed>>

Sync(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ known[c] # epoch
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, inBay, crashed>>

Grant(c) ==
    /\ token = NONE
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ known[c] = epoch
    /\ token' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inBay, known, crashed>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ inBay' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, known, crashed>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ c \in inBay
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {c}
    /\ token' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, crashed>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {c}
    /\ token' = (IF token = c THEN NONE ELSE token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, inBay, known>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Grant(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Exit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    \A c \in inBay : \A d \in inBay : c = d
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2, c3}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT MutualExclusion

nl: A blood-bank inventory network arranges its sites in a token ring, and only the site currently holding the token may touch the shared inventory. The token is passed around the ring as a message carrying a strictly increasing sequence number. Because the network reorders messages, several token-pass messages may be in flight and can arrive in any order. A site accepts an incoming token message only if its sequence number is newer than the highest it has already accepted; older, stale token messages are discarded rather than honored, so a site can never be re-armed by a token it has already superseded. A site that holds the token considers itself armed and may perform an inventory action; when it passes the token it disarms itself. If the token is ever lost from the ring, a recovery re-injects a single fresh token. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state at most one site is armed, and the armed site is exactly the recorded token holder, so no unauthorized or stale site ever acts on the inventory.
spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m1p6t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Sites, MaxSeq, NONE

VARIABLES holder, curSeq, armed, inflight, served
vars == <<holder, curSeq, armed, inflight, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Sites \cup {NONE}
    /\ curSeq \in 0 .. MaxSeq
    /\ armed \subseteq Sites
    /\ inflight \subseteq (Sites \X (0 .. MaxSeq))
    /\ served \subseteq Sites

Init ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ curSeq = 0
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ served = {}

Act(n) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ n \notin served
    /\ served' = served \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, curSeq, armed, inflight>>

Pass(n, m) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ curSeq < MaxSeq
    /\ armed' = armed \ {n}
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<m, curSeq + 1>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curSeq, served>>

Accept(m, s) ==
    /\ <<m, s>> \in inflight
    /\ s > curSeq
    /\ holder' = m
    /\ curSeq' = s
    /\ armed' = armed \cup {m}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED served

DropStale(m, s) ==
    /\ <<m, s>> \in inflight
    /\ s <= curSeq
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, curSeq, armed, served>>

Retire(n) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ curSeq = MaxSeq
    /\ armed' = armed \ {n}
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curSeq, inflight, served>>

Reinject(n) ==
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ holder' = n
    /\ armed' = {n}
    /\ curSeq' = 0
    /\ served' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Act(n)
    \/ \E n \in Sites, m \in Sites : Pass(n, m)
    \/ \E m \in Sites, s \in 0 .. MaxSeq : Accept(m, s)
    \/ \E m \in Sites, s \in 0 .. MaxSeq : DropStale(m, s)
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Retire(n)
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Reinject(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Authorized ==
    /\ \A a \in armed : \A b \in armed : a = b
    /\ (holder = NONE) => (armed = {})
    /\ (holder # NONE) => (armed = {holder})
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Sites = {n1, n2, n3}
    MaxSeq = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT Authorized

nl: A swarm of wildfire-surveillance drones coordinates to drop fire retardant on burning zones. The swarm operates under a single elected leader; when no leader is present one of the live drones is elected, and the current leader can fail at any time, forcing a failover to a fresh election. Only the current leader may order a retardant drop, and each drop is irreversible: once a zone has been doused it is permanently marked doused and can never be set alight again. New fires may ignite, but only on zones that are neither currently burning nor already doused. Each drop consumes one unit of retardant capacity, and that capacity changes at runtime as tankers resupply the swarm up to a maximum. Because dousing is irreversible and re-ignition of a doused zone is forbidden, a zone is doused at most once over the whole run. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state the set of currently burning zones and the set of doused zones are disjoint, so no zone is ever simultaneously burning and doused and no doused zone is ever re-ignited.
spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m3p5t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Zones, MaxCap, NONE

VARIABLES leader, burning, doused, cap, alive
vars == <<leader, burning, doused, cap, alive>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Drones \cup {NONE}
    /\ burning \subseteq Zones
    /\ doused \subseteq Zones
    /\ cap \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ alive \subseteq Drones

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ burning = Zones
    /\ doused = {}
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ alive = Drones

Elect(d) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ d \in alive
    /\ leader' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<burning, doused, cap, alive>>

FailLeader ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<burning, doused, cap, alive>>

Deploy(z) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ z \in burning
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ burning' = burning \ {z}
    /\ doused' = doused \cup {z}
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Ignite(z) ==
    /\ z \notin burning
    /\ z \notin doused
    /\ burning' = burning \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, doused, cap, alive>>

Resupply ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, burning, doused, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Elect(d)
    \/ FailLeader
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Deploy(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Ignite(z)
    \/ Resupply

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Irreversible == burning \cap doused = {}
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    Zones = {z1, z2, z3}
    MaxCap = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT Irreversible

nl: A power-grid load shedder accepts shed commands into a bounded work queue that applies backpressure: once the queue is full, no further commands may be enqueued until room frees up. Authority to issue shed commands rotates through numbered generations; within a generation at most one controller is assigned as the authorized issuer, and that assignment is recorded per generation. Any controller may submit a command tagged with the current generation and its own identity, but a command is executed only if it was issued by the controller that actually owns that generation; commands from any other controller are unauthorized or stale and are dropped instead of executed. The queue's capacity changes at runtime as the operator tunes backpressure up and down within limits. Rotations advance the generation but never rewrite the ownership already recorded for past generations. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state every executed command was issued by the controller recorded as the owner of that command's generation, so no unauthorized or stale controller's command is ever executed.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m4p6t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxGen, MaxCap, NONE

VARIABLES gen, owner, queue, executed, qcap
vars == <<gen, owner, queue, executed, qcap>>

Gens == 0 .. MaxGen
Cmds == Controllers \X Gens

TypeOK ==
    /\ gen \in Gens
    /\ owner \in [Gens -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ queue \subseteq Cmds
    /\ executed \subseteq Cmds
    /\ qcap \in 1 .. MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ owner = [g \in Gens |-> NONE]
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ executed = {}
    /\ qcap = 1

Rotate ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, queue, executed, qcap>>

Assign(c) ==
    /\ owner[gen] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![gen] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, queue, executed, qcap>>

Enqueue(c) ==
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < qcap
    /\ <<c, gen>> \notin queue
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {<<c, gen>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, executed, qcap>>

Execute(c, g) ==
    /\ <<c, g>> \in queue
    /\ owner[g] = c
    /\ executed' = executed \cup {<<c, g>>}
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<c, g>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, qcap>>

Drop(c, g) ==
    /\ <<c, g>> \in queue
    /\ owner[g] # c
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<c, g>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, executed, qcap>>

Recap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1 .. MaxCap
    /\ k # qcap
    /\ qcap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, queue, executed>>

Next ==
    \/ Rotate
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Assign(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Enqueue(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Gens : Execute(c, g)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Gens : Drop(c, g)
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. MaxCap : Recap(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Authorized == \A e \in executed : owner[e[2]] = e[1]
=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {a, b}
    MaxGen = 1
    MaxCap = 2
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT Authorized

nl: A print shop meters ink as a fixed, conserved quantity that is split between a central reservoir and the local tanks of several printers. Ink is only ever moved between the reservoir and a tank; it is never created or destroyed, so the reservoir plus the sum of all printer tanks always equals the shop's total ink budget. Transfers use optimistic locking against a reservoir version number. A printer first reads the reservoir version and issues a transfer request stamped with that version; because requests are reordered on the shop network, they may arrive in any order. A transfer commits only if its stamped version still matches the reservoir's current version and enough ink remains, in which case the reservoir version advances; a request whose stamp no longer matches is a lost optimistic race and is retried. Printers may also recycle ink from their tanks back into the reservoir, and the version counter is periodically compacted. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state the central reservoir plus the sum of every printer's tank equals the fixed total ink budget, so ink is conserved and none is ever created or lost.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m0p2t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Printers, Total, MaxVer

VARIABLES reservoir, tank, ver, inflight
vars == <<reservoir, tank, ver, inflight>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

Reqs == Printers \X (0 .. MaxVer)

TypeOK ==
    /\ reservoir \in 0 .. Total
    /\ tank \in [Printers -> 0 .. Total]
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ inflight \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
    /\ reservoir = Total
    /\ tank = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ inflight = {}

Request(p) ==
    /\ <<p, ver>> \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<p, ver>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank, ver>>

Commit(p, rv) ==
    /\ <<p, rv>> \in inflight
    /\ rv = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ reservoir > 0
    /\ reservoir' = reservoir - 1
    /\ tank' = [tank EXCEPT ![p] = tank[p] + 1]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<p, rv>>}

Retry(p, rv) ==
    /\ <<p, rv>> \in inflight
    /\ rv # ver
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<p, rv>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank, ver>>

Recycle(p) ==
    /\ tank[p] > 0
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ tank' = [tank EXCEPT ![p] = tank[p] - 1]
    /\ reservoir' = reservoir + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Compact ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ inflight' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Request(p)
    \/ \E p \in Printers, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Commit(p, rv)
    \/ \E p \in Printers, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Retry(p, rv)
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Recycle(p)
    \/ Compact

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == reservoir + SumF(tank, Printers) = Total
=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Printers = {pa, pb}
    Total = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INVARIANT Conservation

nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker launches matches onto a small pool of game servers, where each server is a critical resource that may host at most one match at a time. Before a proposed match can be launched, a quorum of distinct players must vote for it. A match is launched onto a free server only once it has quorum and has not been launched before; launching marks the match as launched forever, so it can never be relaunched even after it finishes and frees its server. Any player may crash silently at any time, which removes that player's votes from every match, and a crashed player may later recover. Because a match is launched at most once and only onto a free server, the same match can never be running on two servers simultaneously. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, if a match currently occupies two servers then those two servers are the same, so no match is ever hosted on more than one server at once.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p0t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Matches, Servers, Quorum, NONE

VARIABLES votes, session, launched, crashed
vars == <<votes, session, launched, crashed>>

OnSomeServer(m) == \E s \in Servers : session[s] = m

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Matches -> SUBSET Players]
    /\ session \in [Servers -> Matches \cup {NONE}]
    /\ launched \subseteq Matches
    /\ crashed \subseteq Players

Init ==
    /\ votes = [m \in Matches |-> {}]
    /\ session = [s \in Servers |-> NONE]
    /\ launched = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Vote(p, m) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ p \notin votes[m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = votes[m] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<session, launched, crashed>>

Launch(m, s) ==
    /\ Cardinality(votes[m]) >= Quorum
    /\ session[s] = NONE
    /\ m \notin launched
    /\ ~OnSomeServer(m)
    /\ session' = [session EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ launched' = launched \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

Finish(s) ==
    /\ session[s] # NONE
    /\ session' = [session EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, launched, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ votes' = [m \in Matches |-> votes[m] \ {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<session, launched>>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, session, launched>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, m \in Matches : Vote(p, m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches, s \in Servers : Launch(m, s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Finish(s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Recover(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    \A s \in Servers : \A t \in Servers :
        (session[s] # NONE /\ session[s] = session[t]) => s = t
=============================================================================

nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler finalizes room assignments for surgeries using a compare-and-swap register that carries a version number. A scheduler first reads the version, then proposes a surgery-to-room assignment stamped with the version it read. A proposal commits only if its stamped version still matches the register's current version; committing assigns the room, marks the surgery finalized, and advances the version. Finalization is irreversible and happens at most once per surgery: a finalized surgery can never be proposed again and its assignment can never be cleared. A proposal whose stamp is out of date is not thrown away, because the scheduler that made it is only slow, not failed; instead the proposal is refreshed with the current version and retried. Non-finalized surgeries may have their tentative assignment cancelled, and schedulers may be flagged slow and later un-flagged. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state every finalized surgery has a concrete room assignment (never cleared back to none), so the irreversible finalization of each surgery holds and is never undone.

nl: A bank runs an interbank settlement batch through a bounded work queue that exerts backpressure: settlement instructions may be submitted only while the queue has room, and once it is full no new instruction is admitted until space frees. nl: An elevator bank serves a skyscraper, and each elevator car has a fixed passenger capacity that must never be exceeded. nl: A print shop job spooler uses hierarchical two-level locking to place jobs into tray slots. nl: A container-ship crane yard maintains a shared manifest record that may normally be updated only by the crane currently holding a ring-passed token. A privileged yard administrator may override the token discipline and write an update directly, again committing and acknowledging together. To guarantee no acknowledged update is ever lost, the system separates the durable committed set from the acknowledged set, and a deferred acknowledgement may only confirm an update that is already committed. Every update that is acknowledged to a requester must therefore be present in the durable committed record. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state the set of acknowledged updates is a subset of the set of committed updates, so no update is ever acknowledged without having been durably committed and thus no acknowledged update is lost.

nl: An air-traffic runway allocator grants runway access to inbound flights using a two-phase commit across several runway-control participants. Each allocation transaction begins idle; when it is prepared, participants may cast prepare votes for it. A transaction commits only once every participant has voted to prepare it and only while the number of currently committed allocations is still below the live capacity limit; committing marks the transaction committed and records which runway it was granted. A prepared transaction may instead be aborted. A committed allocation is later released when the flight has landed, returning the transaction to idle and freeing its capacity. The live capacity limit itself changes at runtime as weather and staffing shift the number of runways that can be worked concurrently, though it is never lowered below the number of allocations currently committed. The safety concern is that the number of simultaneously committed allocations never exceeds the current capacity limit. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state the count of committed allocation transactions is at most the current runtime capacity limit, so the runway allocator never over-commits beyond its bounded capacity.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m2p4t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Txns, Participants, Runways, MaxCap, NONE

VARIABLES phase, votes, runwayOf, cap
vars == <<phase, votes, runwayOf, cap>>

Committed == { t \in Txns : phase[t] = "committed" }

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Txns -> {"idle", "prepared", "committed", "aborted"}]
    /\ votes \in [Txns -> SUBSET Participants]
    /\ runwayOf \in [Txns -> Runways \cup {NONE}]
    /\ cap \in 1 .. MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ phase = [t \in Txns |-> "idle"]
    /\ votes = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ runwayOf = [t \in Txns |-> NONE]
    /\ cap = 1

Prepare(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, runwayOf, cap>>

CastVote(p, t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "prepared"
    /\ p \notin votes[t]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = votes[t] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, runwayOf, cap>>

Commit(t, w) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "prepared"
    /\ votes[t] = Participants
    /\ Cardinality(Committed) < cap
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "committed"]
    /\ runwayOf' = [runwayOf EXCEPT ![t] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap>>

AbortTx(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "prepared"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, runwayOf, cap>>

Release(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "committed"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = {}]
    /\ runwayOf' = [runwayOf EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Recap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1 .. MaxCap
    /\ k # cap
    /\ k >= Cardinality(Committed)
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, runwayOf>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Prepare(t)
    \/ \E p \in Participants, t \in Txns : CastVote(p, t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns, w \in Runways : Commit(t, w)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AbortTx(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Release(t)
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. MaxCap : Recap(k)

=============================================================================

nl: A print shop job spooler distributes jobs across several spooler queues, and each queue has a fixed depth that must never be exceeded. Jobs are submitted into a queue, raising its load, and completed jobs leave, lowering it. The spooler reconfigures itself over numbered epochs; each reconfiguration bumps the epoch and re-tunes a queue's routing priority to the new epoch, but it never changes the queue depths and never moves jobs, so it cannot affect how full any queue is. A spooler queue may be flagged as slow but not failed: it keeps its jobs and its place, it merely drains more slowly, so being slow never lets a queue overflow or drop work. The requirement is simply that no queue ever holds more jobs than its fixed depth. SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state every spooler queue's load is at most its fixed depth, so no queue's bounded capacity is ever exceeded.

vars == <<epoch, load, priority, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ load \in [Spoolers -> 0 .. Depth]
    /\ priority \in [Spoolers -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
    /\ slow \subseteq Spoolers

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ load = [q \in Spoolers |-> 0]
    /\ priority = [q \in Spoolers |-> 0]
    /\ slow = {}

    /\ load[q] < Depth
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![q] = load[q] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, priority, slow>>

Complete(q) ==
    /\ load[q] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![q] = load[q] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, priority, slow>>

Reconfigure(q) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ priority' = [priority EXCEPT ![q] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, slow>>

MarkSlow(q) ==
    /\ q \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {q}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, load, priority>>

ClearSlow(q) ==
    /\ q \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {q}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, load, priority>>

Next ==
    \/ \E q \in Spoolers : Submit(q)
    \/ \E q \in Spoolers : Complete(q)
    \/ \E q \in Spoolers : Reconfigure(q)
    \/ \E q \in Spoolers : MarkSlow(q)
    \/ \E q \in Spoolers : ClearSlow(q)
